name: Canned Sliced Beets in Water or Light Pickle
whyItWorks: Canned beets are steam-peeled and cooked until silky tender. They are rich in nitrates and soluble pectin, breaking down smoothly in the upper digestive tract.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Drain liquid and slice into tender bite-sized half-moons. Great paired with soft goat cheese or in a bland grain bowl.
watchOuts: Harmless beeturia: Betacyanin pigments will turn stool and urine deep pink or red. Do not mistake for active gastrointestinal bleeding!
